title: Uniformly Valid Inference Under Interactive and High-Dimensional Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2608.22002v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Asymptotic normality approximations often fail to hold for extremum estimators when the true value of the parameter is at or close to the boundary of a parameter space. I analyze and develop tests using a quasi-unconstrained estimator, which is asymptotically normal even when the true parameter vector is near or at the boundary. These results generalize previous work with this estimator by allowing for more types of constraints and showing how the method can naturally be modified when a nuisance parameter is also high-dimensional. I show that variations of Wald, Likelihood Ratio, and Lagrange Multiplier tests can control size in a uniform sense, provided the initial constrained estimator is sufficiently accurate. Lastly, I apply the method to an application involving network estimation with panel data.

translated_title: 在高维和交互约束下的统一有效推断
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22002v1 公告类型：新 摘要：当参数的真实值位于参数空间的边界或接近边界时，极值估计量的渐近正态近似通常失效。我分析并开发了使用准无约束估计量的检验方法，该估计量即使在真实参数向量接近或位于边界时也是渐近正态的。这些结果通过允许更多类型的约束，并展示了当干扰参数也是高维时如何自然地修改该方法，推广了先前使用该估计量的工作。我证明了Wald、似然比和拉格朗日乘子检验的变体可以在统一意义上控制大小，前提是初始约束估计量足够准确。最后，我将该方法应用于涉及面板数据网络估计的一个实际案例。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于准无约束估计量的检验方法，在参数接近或处于边界时仍保持渐近正态性，并支持高维干扰参数，统一控制Wald、似然比和拉格朗日乘子检验的尺寸。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a testing method based on a quasi-unconstrained estimator that remains asymptotically normal when parameters are near or at boundaries, supports high-dimensional nuisance parameters, and uniformly controls the size of Wald, Likelihood Ratio, and Lagrange Multiplier tests.
